subject: On-prem launch readiness walkthrough and post-launch sanity signoff
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie@acme-cloud.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <ops@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:15 -0700
Subject: On-prem launch readiness walkthrough and acceptance criteria

Team,

We have the targeted on-prem cutover for Acme scheduled for today (12 Jul). This thread will be the canonical pre/post run notes for the launch window. Please confirm you have the following covered by 11:30am PT so we can kick the bridge at 12:00pm PT:

- Network: ACLs pushed, cross-site BGP/session validation, and firewall rules (ports 443, 1024-65535 for ephemeral) verified by Acme.
- DNS: split-horizon records and TTL drop to 60s applied.
- KV cache priming: scripts present in /opt/redwood/priming and validated against sample payloads.
- Time sync: NTP pools set and system clock within 50ms.
- Monitoring: Prometheus scrape targets for the new nodes + alert rules loaded; Grafana dashboard link below.
- Rollback: hot fallback to hosted model endpoints configured; traffic-steering playbook reviewed.
- Runbook: latest runbook_v2.1.pdf attached — follow steps 2.1->2.6 for traffic cut.

Attachments: onprem_preflight_checklist_v1.3.pdf

Ask: Reply with a one-line ack and any blockers. If you are not owning any of the seven preflight items above, note which person is.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 206-555-0189

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie@acme-cloud.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <ops@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem launch readiness walkthrough and acceptance criteria

Ack — quick clarifications before the bridge:

1) Firewall rules: Can Acme confirm that the destination port range for the private NTP and license check (UDP 123 and TCP 443) is open between the on-prem edge and our control-plane IP (34.82.11.9)? Jamie, can you confirm?

2) KV priming: our script primes with three payload sizes (base/medium/large). Will Acme’s acceptance tests include the large payload? If not, we should limit priming to medium to reduce warmup time.

3) Observability: I noticed a mismatch in service labels on the Prometheus scrape for node-4 (prometheus shows redwood-onprem:node4 vs redwood-onprem:node-4). That will break alerting. Monica: can you push a patch to relabel while we’re still in the maintenance window?

On Thu, Jul 12, 2028 at 9:12 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
>
> We have the targeted on-prem cutover for Acme scheduled for today (12 Jul). This thread will be the canonical pre/post run notes for the launch window...

Irene

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie@acme-cloud.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <ops@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:35:30 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem launch readiness walkthrough and acceptance criteria

Thanks — patching the relabel now (will push before 11:00). Jamie/Acme Ops: I pushed a revised runbook (runbook_v2.1.pdf) that toggles the KV priming to medium by default; large is available as an optional step (2.6.3) if you want it.

Canary plan (proposed):
- 12:00pm PT: enable traffic to on-prem for 1% of control-plane users for 10 minutes. Health checks: 200s on /health + token-perf sampling (<80ms p95).
- 12:10pm PT: ramp to 25% for 20 minutes and run smoke matrix (connectivity, inference latency, prefix KV hits, cache hit ratio).
- 12:30pm PT: full cut if no critical alerts.

I will attach the smoke test matrix and a short checklist. Monica attaching runbook_v2.1.pdf and smoke-matrix.csv (referenced).

Monica Patel | Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_v2.1.pdf, smoke-matrix.csv

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie@acme-cloud.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <ops@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:20:45 -0700
Subject: Post-launch sanity check: immediate smoke results (summary)

Bridge recap and quick results (executive summary):

- Timeline: Canary started at 12:00pm PT; ramp to 25% completed by 12:12pm PT; full traffic by 12:31pm PT.
- Smoke outcomes: all core checks passed. See attached smoke-results-20280712.txt for full logs. Key highlights:
  - /health endpoints: 0 HTTP 5xx across ramp.
  - p95 inference latency: 82ms (target <100ms).
  - KV cache hit ratio: 94% after priming (target >=90%).
  - Prometheus metrics: relabel patch applied; alerts suppressed for maintenance window triggered correctly.

Open items (non-blocking):
- One edge node (node-7) experienced intermittent 30-90s UDP jitter during the 25% ramp. We shifted traffic off node-7 at 12:18pm and rebalanced; logs indicate a NIC driver timeout. Vivek to follow up; recommended to schedule a hardware-drain next week.
- Doc link for smoke logs + screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Redwood-AcmeGoLive (added).

Attachments: smoke-results-20280712.txt

Sergio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Li <jamie@acme-cloud.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <ops@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem launch readiness walkthrough and acceptance criteria — final signoff & archive request

Excellent work team — thanks for the swift execution and clear notes. On behalf of Customer Success and Ops, I am signing off on the production transition. A few follow-ups for the backlog:

- Vivek: open a hardware ticket for node-7 investigation and include a recommended replacement window.
- Monica: update runbook_v2.2 with the node-drain step and add the KV large payload as an optional appendix.
- Sergio: please attach the signed acceptance (DocuSign) to the HubSpot deal and mark the milestone "onprem:prod-live".

I'll close the operational bridge notes after you confirm artifacts are uploaded. Marissa will own the post-launch retrospective and schedule it for next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Global Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
